text.en:
The provisions of the National Internal Revenue Code and other existing laws to the contrary
notwithstanding, the income tax due on the net purse payable to Muhammad Ali/Herbert Muhammad and Joe
Frazier/Smokin' Joe, Inc. shall be held by the Philippine National Bank and applied to the obligations of the
Games and Amusement Board incurred with the said Bank in connection with the "ALI-FRAZIER FIGHT";

All other taxes, levies and assessments collected in connection with the "ALI-FRAZIER
FIGHT" shall be turned over by the Bureau of Internal Revenue to GAB to effectuate the purpose of this
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
